The opponent at 9 life facing a 4/4 Marauding Mako and a Detective's Phoenix already has pressure they need to answer. Removing their best remaining threat (Psychic Frog) could be better than removing Counterspell, especially since Stubborn Denial is still in hand and the opponent's Nethergoyf isn't at 4 power yet so Stubborn Denial is just a Force Spike. Taking Psychic Frog removes their card advantage engine and best creature, while the remaining countermagic may not matter if they're under enough pressure. However, taking Counterspell is reasonable since it protects future plays and the opponent may not have the mana to deploy Frog effectively while under pressure.
